summary: Vista Energy filed a 6-K announcing proved reserves from its May 2026 acquisition of working interests in Argentina's Vaca Muerta shale: 25.1% in Bandurria Sur and 35.0% in Bajo del Toro, adding 66.8 MMboe of P1 reserves. The transaction involved acquiring Equinor's stake in Bandurria Sur via BSP and a 50% working interest in Bajo del Toro, partially selling BSP shares to YPF. No price or premium disclosed. The filing focuses on reserve estimates, not terms. Watch for development of 237 remaining well locations; regulatory permits for Bajo del Toro Norte exploration expire end-2026.
